TestHeatWeightedLB::test_heat_weighted_l.description: Thin wrapper around run_heat_weighted_load_balancing(cl): 3-node RF=3 cluster (3 racks), c-s write 5000 rows at cl=QUORUM, flush, then 1m c-s read at cl=QUORUM while sampling scylla_storage_proxy_coordinator_reads_local_node and per-table cache_hit_rate for 60s; asserts per-node read deltas within 0.25x-4x of node2 and equal hit rates. Then restarts node2 (cold cache), reads again and asserts node2 serves fewer reads (others/node2 ratio 0.8..~13) and its hit rate grows monotonically. Guards end-to-end heat-weighted load balancing (cache_hit_rate_read_balancing, cache_temperature propagated via read RPC, db/heat_load_balance.hh). The cl param only affects the write phase.
